title: The Call of the Gospel
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The call of the Gospel is God’s outward summons through the message of Christ, calling sinners to repent, believe, and come to Him for salvation. The Gospel must be proclaimed clearly because sinners must hear the good news of Jesus.
summary: The call of the Gospel is God’s outward summons through the message of Christ, calling sinners to repent, believe, and come to Him for salvation. The Gospel must be proclaimed clearly because sinners must hear the good news of Jesus.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the One announced in the Gospel call. The call does not invite people to vague religion, but to the crucified and risen Savior who forgives, reconciles, and gives eternal life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God calls sinners through the proclaimed Gospel. The message announces who Christ is, what He has done, the reality of sin and judgment, and the promise of salvation for all who call on the Lord.

The Gospel call includes both invitation and command. Sinners are invited to come to Christ, and they are commanded to repent and believe. This call is gracious, serious, urgent, and true.

The outward call must be clear. It is not enough to offer encouragement, morality, or religious language. People must hear of sin, the cross, the resurrection, repentance, faith, forgiveness, and life in Christ.

The church is entrusted with this message as ambassadors for Christ. God pleads through His people as they call others to be reconciled to Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
A confused Gospel call produces confused responses. People may think Christianity is mainly about self-help, belonging, politics, morality, or emotional comfort if Christ is not clearly proclaimed.

This doctrine gives urgency to evangelism and preaching. People cannot believe in the One of whom they have not heard. The church must lovingly and clearly call sinners to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Make the Gospel call clear when you speak of salvation. Do not hide repentance, faith, the cross, or the resurrection. Invite people to Christ with compassion and seriousness, trusting God to work through His Word as sinners hear the good news.
